qs.en: She has little experience in this field.

qs.en: This bag is a bit heavy for me.

qs.en: He is a bit nervous before the exam.

qs.en: Could you speak slightly more slowly, please?

qs.en: There are two coats on the chair; which one do you want to try on?

qs.en: There were two witnesses in the room; who did you question first?

qs.en: She works for a company for which the quality of products is paramount.

qs.en: The director announced that he was preparing the sequel to the film.

qs.s: J'espère que vous ___ le message.

qs.s: Elle ___ mieux avec une bonne traduction.

qs.en: We would understand the rule with more examples.

qs.s: Vous ___ mieux si vous écoutiez attentivement.
qs.en: You would understand better if you listened carefully.

qs.s: Avec plus d'entraînement, vous ___ le texte facilement.
qs.en: With more practice, you would understand the text easily.

qs.s: Mes collègues ___ si on leur expliquait clairement.

qs.s: Elles ___ mieux avec un exemple concret.

qs.en: The library contains more than fifty thousand volumes.

qs.en: We agreed on every point of the agreement.

qs.en: The team scored three points in the last minute and won the match.

qs.en: He raised an interesting point during the meeting.

qs.en: The meeting was cancelled; we were thus able to enjoy the afternoon.

qs.en: He finally arrived in time to have dinner with us.

qs.s: Il a passé ___ heure à corriger ses erreurs.
qs.en: He spent an hour correcting his mistakes.

qs.en: The meeting lasted an hour and a half.
